verdict.rationale: Segment documents Reverse ETL, which extracts warehouse data using a query you provide and syncs it to third-party destinations, so warehouse data can be activated without re-collecting it. The audience half of the story rests mainly on a pricing-page claim about building audiences from data already in the warehouse; the Audiences docs describe building audiences from tracked events, traits and computed traits rather than directly on warehouse tables. Missing for 10: documented warehouse-native audience definition on existing tables, documentation of model definition beyond a query, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can run warehouse-native: define models and audiences on tables already in my warehouse and activate them without re-collecting the data (reverse ETL)

citations.quote: Reverse ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) extracts data from a warehouse using a query you provide and syncs this warehouse data to your third party destinations.
Leverage data already stored in the warehouse to enrich unified profiles, and build complex audiences to precisely target customers with personalized communications.
Unify events and warehouse data into governed, identity‑resolved profiles
